National Champ On The Move
Armin Krueger Photo
A. J. Foyt of Houston, Tex. (#1-Sheraton-Thompson Ford), the defending national champ, was on the
move as he wedged his way under two other cars in a practice run for the June 9 150 mile Rex Mays Classic
here. Others in the picture were: #14-Sam Sessions of Nashville, Mich. (Caves turbo-charged Offy) and Mario
Andretti of Nazareth, Pa. (#2-Overseas International Airways Ford). Andretti finished second, Sessions was 11th
and Foyt, 14th.

Mario Encounters 'Silent Sam'
Dan Sheek Photo
A funny thing happened to Mario Andretti early in the June 9 150 mile Rex Mays Classic here. Mario (in
#2-Overseas International Airways Ford) was clipping along when all of a sudden "Silent Sam," one of two STP
Turbines in the race, eased up side of him. Art Pollard of Medford, Ore., was at the Turbine's controls. Art
later slipped past Mario and led the race for one mile before teammate Joe Leonard of San Jose, Calif., in a
second TP Turbine took over the top spot. Andretti came on to finish second. Pollard wound up 16th, being
blackflagged out of the race with a fuel line leak. Leonard lost the right rear wheel and spun up to the wall
after a little more than a third of the race was run.
